findings.result: Correctly requires current ownership, excludes primary calendars and restricts work/school handoff to the same organisation. Secondary-only scope is conveyed by the primary exclusion and link to Google instructions; no promise that every shared calendar can transfer.
Correctly distinguishes sending an email from completion: 60 days to accept, sender remains owner until acceptance. Does not recommend account deletion or equate file import with a completed handoff.
Both heading and paragraphs explicitly constrain ownership handoff to Google. No Cloud transfer UI or cross-provider ownership migration is invented; existing import fidelity cautions remain.
The two-paragraph addition supplies an actionable decision absent from the original export guide without repeating the existing FAQ. No audit-speak, ranking or runtime claim introduced.
